newGrammars.query:
WITH RECURSIVE
outcome0 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS k,n.file,n.id AS node,9223372036854775807 AS work,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.file ORDER BY n.id) AS ordinal FROM node n WHERE 1 AND n.kind IN (142)
),
outcome1 AS (
SELECT NULL AS k,file,NULL AS node,0 AS ordinal,0 AS truth,9223372036854775807 AS work,NULL AS c0 FROM outcome0 GROUP BY file
UNION ALL
SELECT d.k,d.file,d.node,d.ordinal,r.c0,r.c1,r.c2 FROM outcome1 w CROSS JOIN outcome0 d ON d.file=w.file AND d.ordinal=w.ordinal+1 CROSS JOIN relation_row r ON (r.c0,r.c1,r.c2) IS (WITH RECURSIVE outcome0 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT 1 AS k,d.file AS file,d.node AS node,w.work AS work WHERE 1
),
outcome1 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.k,d.file,d.node,d.work,1 AS truth,NULL AS c0,0 AS u0 FROM outcome0 d
